latest_release.name: v1.4.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Flag failed tool results as errors when sending them to Anthropic by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1250
* Keep the Anthropic tool definitions cache breakpoint off deferred tools by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1249
* Honor the agent tool choice with Anthropic native structured output by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1251
* [1.x] Replay reasoning on the OpenAI-compatible provider in tool loops by @Tarek-yagami in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1245
* [1.x] Keep the provider call id when replaying an AG-UI tool result by @ChrisReid in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1241
* [1.x] Stream tool input as it arrives by @vinitkadam03 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1239
* [1.x] Honor the Strict attribute on Mistral and OpenRouter tools by @medilies in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1233

## New Contributors
* @Tarek-yagami made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1245
* @ChrisReid made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1241

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/laravel/ai/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

detail.readme: ## Introduction The Laravel AI SDK provides a unified, expressive API for interacting with AI providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more. With the AI SDK, you can build intelligent agents with tools and structured output, generate images, synthesize and transcribe audio, create vector embeddings, and much more — all using a consistent, Laravel-friendly interface. ## Documentation Documentation for the Laravel AI SDK can be found on the [Laravel website](https://laravel.com/docs/ai-sdk). ## Contributing Thank you for considering contributing to Laravel! The contribution guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions). ## Code of Conduct In order to ensure that the Laravel community is welcoming to all, please review and abide by the [Code of Conduct](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#code-of-conduct). ## Security Vulnerabilities Please review [our security policy](https://github.com/laravel/ai/security/policy) on how to report security vulnerabilities. ## License The Laravel AI SDK is open-sourced software licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).
